decks.summary: Guide Lucius who evades by 2 or more every turn with String Along, Pickpocketing and Alton O'Connell for clues and cards, and turns oversuccess into value with Antikythera and Fine Tuning.
Oversucceeding Lucius on a Fine-Tuned Antikythera and Microscope, boosting tests with Steady-Handed, Inquisitive and Deduction, and evading with Pickpocketing and String Along.
Solo Ascetic Lucius who refreshes The Necronomicon with Library Pass and Scroll of Secrets every turn, recharging with Ariadne's Twine and charging Eon Chart with Truth from Fiction.
Two-player level 0 main cluever Lucius who evades every turn with String Along and Pickpocketing for a resource, card and clue, investigating with Forensic Kit and Thieves' Kit.
Katana Lucius at 41 XP who fights at combat 1 by hitting exactly 2 with Eye of the Djinn, Occult Reliquary, Steady-Handed and Inquisitive, with Versatile to reach the Katana.
The first published Lucius, at 0 XP: Fingerprint and Thieves' Kits with Milan, Grim Memoir and Lucky Cigarette Case to draw off big successes, and Sneak By to evade and move.
True solo level 0 Lucius for The Drowned City who oversucceeds with Magnifying Glass, Grim Memoir and "Watch this!", and handles enemies with British Bull Dogs and Sneak Attack.
Extra-action Lucius with two Leo De Lucas, Haste and Pathfinder, sweeping locations with Archaic Glyphs and Higher Education, fuelled by The Red Clock, Eldritch Sophist and Easy Mark.
Red Clock Lucius who moves a charge each turn with Eldritch Sophist onto Archaic Glyphs or Blur for +3, evading by 2 for his clue or sweeping clues when no enemy is around.
Librarionomicon Lucius who loops The Necronomicon through Library Pass and Scroll of Secrets, refilled by Ariadne's Twine and Eldritch Sophist, with Research Librarians to find the pieces.
